Affix.Name: Empyrean Sojourn
Affix.Desc: Increases the equipping character's Elemental Skill and Elemental Burst DMG by 25%. More effects will be revealed in later versions.

EQUIP_RING.Name: Goblet of the Empyrean Sojourn
EQUIP_RING.Desc: It was a goblet of wine she had accepted in celebration from the hands of a colleague.

EQUIP_NECKLACE.Name: Plume of the Empyrean Sojourn
EQUIP_NECKLACE.Desc: It was a feathered quill given to her followers, once used to pen the most absurd of dreams.

EQUIP_DRESS.Name: Circlet of the Empyrean Sojourn
EQUIP_DRESS.Desc: It was a delicate trinket awarded to her in praise by the hand of her only master.

EQUIP_BRACER.Name: Flower of the Empyrean Sojourn
EQUIP_BRACER.Desc: It was a flower made of silk, gifted to her by a friend whose hands were as cold as ice.

EQUIP_SHOES.Name: Sands of the Empyrean Sojourn
EQUIP_SHOES.Desc: It was a fleeting moment she gave a certain silent alchemist to remind him of every item on his schedule.
